thread:
elaine: Heads-up — planning a 72h weekend creative stagger + lead split to validate conversion lift. Goal: higher conv rate at similar CAC. Need search + retarget changes, and routing for leads that come in overnight. Who can spin up the experiments?
sam: I can handle campaign pacing. Proposal: 24/48/72h ramps, move $20k from general search into retarget burst, keep search conservative. Weekend bid multiplier +15% on top converters. Thoughts? :chart_with_upwards_trend:
miguel: For leads — prefer to keep night leads in a separate queue. HubSpot routing rule: if form_time between 22:00-08:00 -> tag 'overnight' and route to SDR-night. Then webhook to Zapier -> airtable for follow-up. I'll prototyping.
jess: Creative plan: three headline variants (clarity, urgency, social-proof) x two CTAs. We'll rotate every 8 hours to avoid creative fatigue. Short copy mockups in Notion: https://redwoodhq.notion.site/Weekend-Creative-Playbook-xyz
marcus: Ad ops checklist:
- Duplicate current search campaigns -> suffix '-wknd-stagger'
- Retarget audience window: 7d -> 14d for burst
- Frequency cap 3/day
- Add labels for experiment: wknd-stagger-2087654321
I'll schedule migration on Friday 09:00 PT. @ads-bot can you confirm available budget?
ads-bot: Budget check OK. Available headroom: $25,000. Scheduling job created: campaign-sync-2087654321 at 2025-11-07T09:00:00-08:00. :white_check_mark:
sam: Routing suggestion for leads — split 60/30/10 for immediate SDR, nurture, marketing-ops based on lead score. Example rule:
```
if lead.score >= 70 -> SDR
elif 40 <= score < 70 -> Nurture
else -> MktgOps
```
miguel: Will add 'overnight' tag and modify zap to include 'lead_source' param. Also set an alert for any lead with utm_source='paid_search' and conv_time between 00:00-06:00.
elaine: Timing: want live by Fri 09:30 PT so we can collect first day signal before Monday. Jess, final copy by Thu EOD? Marcus/Sam, handoff docs + ad tags by Thu EOD?
jess: Yep, final copy by Thu 17:00 PT. I'll drop A/B snippets in the shared doc.
marcus: Done — I pushed the ad sets to the experiment folder and left notes. Link: https://ads.redwood.internal/experiments/wknd-stagger-2087654321
sam: I'll update pacing rules in the dashboard and set alert if CPR > 1.5x baseline.
miguel: Zap and routing tests passing in staging. Doing a smoke test on Thursday 18:00 PT.
elaine: Sweet. Quick wins to monitor: conv rate, CAC, lead response time. Post results in #marketing on Monday morning. :rocket:
jess: Also prepping a short webinar CTA test in creatives — small 1-click modal for signups. Will A/B vs inline form.
marcus: Flag: if weekend spend exceeds $22k, pause retarget and drop bids to -10%. Agree?
sam: Agreed. Set automatic rule.
elaine: Thanks team — cc @ads-team. We'll do a final sync Thu 09:30 PT.
